reason: Conversation 1 correctly prioritised airflow, gave accurate heater-circuit diagnosis with the TCO as most likely given the clogged hose, insisted on unplugging before any panel removal, flagged fluff as a fire risk, suggested a cheap meter, and never proposed bypassing a cut-out; its weakness is nudging the customer to order a thermostat kit without a test or full model and not suggesting an engineer. Conversation 2 was honest in refusing to name a part and asked a sensible first step, but then stalled for two turns on 'get the model number', never addressed the no-multimeter problem, never raised the engineer option, and gave the customer no real path forward. Conversation 1's actionable, safety-conscious guidance outweighs its slightly over-eager part suggestion.
